claims.text: UT REAL Health AI is The University of Texas Research, Engineering, and Application Laboratory for Healthcare Artificial Intelligence.
claims.quote: The University of Texas Research, Engineering, and Application Laboratory for Healthcare Artificial Intelligence (UT REAL Health AI)

claims.text: The University of Texas System launched UT REAL Health AI in 2025 as a systemwide initiative after it received legislative approval and dedicated funding.
claims.quote: In 2025, the University of Texas System received legislative approval and dedicated funding to launch UT REAL Health AI, a systemwide initiative to responsibly accelerate artificial intelligence in health.

claims.text: Dr. Nyma Shah of UT MD Anderson Cancer Center is the executive director of UT REAL Health AI.
claims.quote: Executive Director: Dr. Nyma Shah, UT MD Anderson Cancer Center

claims.text: Dr. Peter McCaffrey of UTMB chairs UT REAL Health AI.
claims.quote: Chair: Dr. Peter McCaffrey, UT Medical Branch (UTMB)

claims.text: Zain Kazmi of the UT System Office of Health Affairs is the executive sponsor of UT REAL Health AI.
claims.quote: Executive Sponsor: Zain Kazmi, UT System Office of Health Affairs

claims.text: UT REAL Health AI announced funding for 12 pilot projects to advance the use of AI in health care across the UT System. The release page carries no date.
claims.quote: today announced funding for 12 pilot projects designed to advance the use of AI in healthcare across the UT System

claims.text: The 12 pilot awards were chosen through a two-phase review of 120 systemwide submissions.
claims.quote: Selected through a rigorous two-phase review of 120 systemwide submissions

claims.text: The pilot awards total more than $3.6 million across eleven UT institutions.
claims.quote: Competitive awards totaling more than $3.6 million support AI innovation in emergency care, patient safety, clinical efficiency, and medical education across eleven UT institutions.

claims.text: Three of the 12 projects, described as moonshots, each received up to $500,000.
claims.quote: Three moonshot projects each received up to $500,000 to pursue transformative clinical AI.

claims.text: Bedside Emergency AI for Care Orchestration is a funded pilot at UT San Antonio led by Dr. Amina Qutub.
claims.quote: Bedside Emergency AI for Care Orchestration (UT San Antonio, PI: Dr. Amina Qutub

claims.text: The UT San Antonio pilot puts an AI clinical assistant called Leah across seven UT hospital sites for emergency triage and transfer decisions. The page says Leah was trained on more than 400,000 trauma cases.
claims.quote: deploys "Leah," an AI clinical assistant trained on more than 400,000 trauma cases, across seven UT hospital sites to optimize emergency triage and transfer decisions

claims.text: A smartphone tool that uses AI to detect fetal movements to help prevent stillbirth is a funded pilot at UT Austin led by Dr. Kenneth Moise.
claims.quote: Smartphone Detection of Fetal Movements Using Artificial Intelligence: A Novel Approach to Prevent Stillbirth (UT Austin, PI: Dr. Kenneth Moise

claims.text: A UT Southwestern pilot led by Dr. Dylan Owens works on automating clinical registry abstraction with AI.
claims.quote: Reimagining Clinical Registry Abstraction with Uncertainty-Aware, Self-Improving AI (UT Southwestern, PI: Dr. Dylan Owens

claims.text: At UTMB Galveston, Dr. Salim Hayek leads a funded pilot that deploys AI referral triage to reduce low-value care and improve patient access.
claims.quote: At UTMB Galveston, Dr. Salim Hayek is deploying AI Referral Triage to Reduce Low-Value Care and Improve Patient Access

claims.text: At UTHealth Houston, Dr. Aanand Naik leads a funded pilot that scales Priorities AI toward Medicare age-friendly health care designation.
claims.quote: At UTHealth Houston, Dr. Aanand Naik is scaling Priorities AI Scaling and Implementation to Achieve Medicare Age-Friendly Healthcare Designation

claims.text: At UT Dell Medical School, Dr. Salim Saiyed leads a funded pilot on an AI tool for patient engagement and clinical efficiency.
claims.quote: At UT Dell Medical School, Dr. Salim Saiyed is leading AI Tool for Patient Engagement and Clinical Efficiency Enhancement

claims.text: A funded pilot to expand AI-powered no-show reduction across UT System health institutions is led by Dr. Xiaoqian Jian, as the page spells it.
claims.quote: Expanding AI-Powered No-Show Reduction Across UT System Health Institutions, led by Dr. Xiaoqian Jian

claims.text: A pilot led by Dr. Ming Huang at UT Dell Medical School will use large language models on free-text clinical notes across more than 7 million patient records. It aims to improve suicide risk detection.
claims.quote: led by Dr. Ming Huang at UT Dell Medical School will use large language models to analyze free-text clinical notes across more than 7 million patient records. The system will identify suicidal ideation and life stressors, including unemployment and financial strain, to improve suicide risk detection

claims.text: An AI early warning system against wrong-tooth extraction in oral and maxillofacial surgery is a funded pilot led by Dr. Sayali Tungare at UTHealth Houston.
claims.quote: Early Warning System to Predict Wrong-Tooth Extraction (WTE) in Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery (Predict-WTE) led by Dr. Sayali Tungare at UTHealth Houston

claims.text: One funded pilot expands an AI clinical trial prescreening platform first validated on nearly 40,000 patients at UT Southwestern.
claims.quote: expands a clinical trial prescreening platform previously validated on nearly 40,000 patients at UT Southwestern

claims.text: One funded pilot expands an AI grading platform for medical school simulation exams. The platform has been in continuous use for more than three years and has supported more than 3,500 encounters.
claims.quote: expands an AI grading platform that has been in continuous operational use for more than three years and has supported more than 3,500 simulation encounters

claims.text: A pilot led by Dr. Andrea Cooley at UT Tyler uses AI to expand access to retinal screening.
claims.quote: led by Dr. Andrea Cooley at UT Tyler, uses artificial intelligence to expand access to retinal screening and early disease detecting at scale

claims.text: The UT REAL Health AI page says the no-show reduction project has already saved more than 6,500 appointments and $900,000 in revenue at UTHealth Houston. The page cites no measurement or audit behind the figure.
claims.quote: that has already saved more than 6,500 appointments and $900,000 in revenue at UTHealth Houston

claims.text: The no-show project is set to expand to UT Health San Antonio, where the page projects it will recover 15,000 to 20,000 appointments a year.
claims.quote: The project will now expand to UT Health San Antonio, where it is projected to recover 15,000–20,000 appointments annually.

claims.text: The 2026 UT REAL Health AI Symposium is set for October 7th and 8th in Austin.
claims.quote: 2026 UT REAL Health AI Symposium - October 7-8, Austin, TX

claims.text: ERCOT told its board that it has paused energizing new large load data centers and crypto mining facilities until its verification and audit and its community impact review are complete.
claims.quote: ERCOT has paused the energization of new Large Load data centers and crypto mining facilities until the completion of the verification and audit and community impact review.

claims.text: ERCOT listed among its actions a pause on approvals to energize data centers and crypto mining facilities of 75 MW or more.
claims.quote: Paused approvals to energize data centers or virtual currency mining facilities (crypto facilities) that are 75 MW or greater.

claims.text: ERCOT said the pause covers large load data centers and crypto facilities that are not yet connected to its system.
claims.quote: Energization pause impacts Large Load data centers and crypto facilities not yet connected to the ERCOT system.

claims.text: ERCOT said it will file its Batch Zero eligibility verification report with the Public Utility Commission of Texas by December 10th, 2026.
claims.quote: ERCOT will file the Batch Zero Eligibility Verification Report with the Commission by December 10, 2026.

claims.text: ERCOT said it will file a community impact review report with the Public Utility Commission of Texas by December 10th, 2026.
claims.quote: ERCOT will file the Community Impact Review Report with the Commission by December 10, 2026.

claims.text: The Batch Zero update went to the ERCOT Board of Directors meeting of September 14th to 15th, 2026.
claims.quote: Board of Directors Meeting September 14-15, 2026

claims.text: A release on NextEra's newsroom dated September 30th, 2026 says the U.S. Department of Commerce and the Republic of Korea selected Related Companies and NextEra Energy Resources, with Lewis Energy Group, to develop Project Star in Encinal.
claims.quote: The U.S. Department of Commerce and the Republic of Korea selected Related Companies and NextEra Energy Resources, in partnership with Lewis Energy Group, to develop Project Star

claims.text: The companies say Project Star will build 6.47 GW of natural gas generation to serve an adjacent 5 GW campus and send excess power to the grid.
claims.quote: Project Star will create 6.47 GW of natural gas generation to directly support an adjacent 5 GW digital infrastructure campus and deliver excess power generation back to the grid.

claims.text: The release says Related Digital is developing the privately funded 5 GW data center campus on an adjacent site.
claims.quote: At full scale, Project Star will support a privately funded 5 GW data center campus that Related Digital is developing on an adjacent site.

claims.text: The release says initial generation could come online as early as 2029 and remains subject to required permitting and approvals.
claims.quote: initial generating resources anticipated to come online as early as 2029, subject to required permitting and approvals

claims.text: The UTMB referral triage tool reads health record documentation, assigns an urgency score and routes each patient to a level of care.
claims.quote: The tool analyzes EHR documentation, assigns urgency scores, and routes patients to the appropriate level of care.

claims.text: The UTHealth Houston Priorities AI pilot is a conversational agent that asks older adults about their surgical goals before they meet their surgeon.
claims.quote: a conversational agent that identifies older adults' surgical outcome goals before meeting with their surgeon

claims.text: The Dell Medical School pilot implements six AI tools built into Epic. Among their aims are automating lab result messaging and generating patient-facing imaging summaries.
claims.quote: which implements six Epic-integrated AI tools to automate lab result messaging, generate patient-facing imaging summaries

claims.text: The wrong-tooth pilot pairs computer vision on dental images with language processing of surgical notes.
claims.quote: will combine computer vision analysis of dental imaging with natural language processing of surgical documentation to help prevent wrongful tooth extraction

claims.text: The stillbirth pilot is a smartphone app that listens for fetal movements, with an accuracy the page gives as 88%.
claims.quote: is a smartphone app that uses AI-powered acoustic analysis to detect fetal movements with 88% accuracy

claims.text: ERCOT said it acted on the Governor's August 3rd, 2026 directive on connecting data centers and crypto mining loads.
claims.quote: ERCOT took immediate actions to address Governor Abbott's August 3, 2026 directive related to the interconnection of data centers and crypto mining loads.

claims.text: The UT REAL Health AI home page links to registration for the 2026 symposium.
claims.quote: Visit Symposium Site | Register Now | Submit an Abstract

rejected.finding: Announcement date of the 12 UT REAL Health AI pilot awards
rejected.reason: No fetched page dates it. The pilot page says 'today announced' and carries no date on three reads, and the UT System news listing carries no pilot item.

rejected.finding: No-show project lead spelled 'Dr. Xiaoqian Jiang'
rejected.reason: The pilot page prints 'Dr. Xiaoqian Jian' on all three reads.
The page does not say which institution the lead belongs to, only that the savings were at UTHealth Houston.

rejected.finding: Houston reporting: leadership declined detailed questions on patient data
rejected.reason: The article says leaders could not be reached or declined to answer questions about how the program would achieve its stated aims. The patient data framing is not supported.

rejected.finding: UT Austin access for every student, faculty and staff member
rejected.reason: The page says the campus community and its entire community.
Wire reprint. The same release is on NextEra's newsroom, which is cited instead.

rejected.finding: Project Star announced by NextEra and Related
rejected.reason: The release headline says the U.S. Department of Commerce and the Government of the Republic of Korea announce. Related and NextEra are the selected developers.

rejected.finding: Project Star in La Salle County
rejected.reason: The release never places the campus site in La Salle County.

rejected.reason: yahoo.com disallows this project in robots.txt on that path, measured by fetch_doc on 2026-10-05. The record does not rest on a disallowed source. The Chronicle's own page was not found on a host the registry allows.

rejected.reason: tech.utexas.edu answered 403 to this project's fetcher on 2026-10-05. The item is held until the page can be re-read.
